description.to:
Human-facing CLI for diagnose to marked findings to rewrite options or redline-style suggestions to an explicit diff. Config comes from a local style-rules file. No Papyrus required.

Dependencies:
- blocked-by: LIM-dca47857-e14f-4c66-aa4a-37200a524880

Feature: Human-steered CLI editing
  Scenario: Apply one chosen finding option
    Given a diagnosis and a human-selected option for one finding
    When the operator applies it to an explicit working-copy path
    Then only that anchored patch changes the working copy
    And Limatus presents a diff while preserving the original draft
